_example: EXAMPLE CONFIG — copy this, do not run it. Practitioner Brief DOCX build configuration for build_drds_docx.py, used via --config. The Brief builds from the same renderer as the Owner Report with no code changes, which is the evidence that the tool generalises across document shapes rather than needing a script per document.
_paths: REPLACE ALL FOUR. 'root' is an absolute path; the other three are relative to it. The renderer reads source_md and writes out_docx — it never writes back to the Markdown. Point out_docx at a NEW filename per version; never overwrite an approved baseline.
_page: A4, matching the Owner Report baseline.
_palette: Identical to the Owner Report so the two documents read as one package.
_type: Smaller headings than the Owner Report. The Brief is a work list, not a document to be impressed by, so it should read as more functional and less decorative.
_behaviour: Same guardrails as the Owner Report. render_internal_markers MUST stay true until a recorded client-ready decision.
_page_breaks: PER-DOCUMENT EDITORIAL DATA — DO NOT COPY THIS LIST TO ANOTHER DOCUMENT TYPE. Note that it differs from the Owner Report's list, and matches on prefix text rather than section number, because the Brief's headings are named not numbered. The principle is what carries over: work items break, closing support flows. In the validated Brief shape, items 1-5 each start a new page so they stay separate work blocks a practitioner can work through one at a time, and 'Before you start' is closing guidance that flows after item 5. Adopted after a measured experiment: 9 pages to 8, average page fill 64% to 72%, earlier pages unchanged, and the last item became less visually dominant rather than more. A document with differently named sections needs its own list, decided the same way. An exempted heading gets the identical heading treatment, page break aside — no extra spacing above.
_pagination: The work-list table must stay whole: splitting it orphaned the last item and gave the lowest-priority item unearned prominence. Callout panels must not split either: an opening-order change exposed that defect.
_cosmetic: Shared cover policy, identical to the Owner Report.
